Transaction facts (e.g. FactSales) are additive — SUM works correctly across any date range because each row is an independent event.

Snapshot facts (e.g. FactTargets, inventory, headcount, account balances) represent a point-in-time state. Summing snapshot rows across multiple months double-counts the same balance.

Left table: 'Target Sales Amount' (plain SUM) inflates as more months are in context.

Right table: 'Target Sales Amount (Ending Balance)' resolves the latest snapshot month within the current filter context and returns only that month's value — the correct semi-additive pattern.
